generation_constraints: Use language-skills integration instead of a generic content subject exam.
Scale text length, vocabulary, and writing load to the phase.
validation_rules: Choose the render shell from assessment design before rendering learner-facing material.
Do not render practical performance tasks as written answer-question papers.
Marks in the learner pack must reconcile with the assessment instrument.
Keep educator approval as the final gate.
